image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of two open containers of ice cream. The foreground container holds a scoop of light beige or off-white ice cream with a textured surface. The background container holds a darker, brownish-grey ice cream. Both containers have colorful, cartoon-style branding with text that appears distorted and illegible. There are graphic overlays of fruit slices (mango/peach) and blue/yellow shapes in the background and foreground, suggesting a stylized or edited composition.
